name: Custom Framing & World of Sports Memorabilia
addr: 82 S Montgomery St, San Jose, CA 95110
audience: Collectors, athletes and families preserving jerseys, rings, bibs and art
description: A downtown San Jose shop doing museum-grade custom framing and authenticated sports memorabilia under one roof: shadow boxes, jersey mounts, jersey framing, and in-person JSA signing events.
serviceCopy: Matting, moulding and UV glazing, specified.
Shadow boxes built to the object.
Authenticated jerseys, cards and signing events.
insight: Two businesses in one lease is a genuine architecture problem - the site must resolve the identity, which is exactly what a $10K+ engagement buys.
usps: One shop for the frame and the piece
differentiators: Publishes a mounting gallery by object type (jersey, ring, bib, guitar) and a framing material explainer

afford: Museum framing projects $200-$3,000; collector cases reach five figures
Inventory-backed retail plus service business: two revenue engines
Thirty-six years downtown with a known name in collector circles
risk: Collectibles carry authentication liability: publish their process, not guarantees
Dual brand needs IA decisions before pixels

art.photoNote: Depth mounts, UV glass edges, glove-handled cards

copy.lede: This shop has spent thirty-six years mounting the things people cannot replace, on a domain that only mentions half of what it does.

concept.dir: Archive and vitrine layout: dark museum walls, object-in-case photography, a mounting-method selector by object type, and a materials spec table. Restrained motion, precise captions.
interactive: Object-type mount selector (jersey, ring, medal, guitar, art)
Quote request with measurements and object photo upload
concept.refs: A museum services page crossed with a collector shop.

web.note: Directory record lists the memorabilia domain only: one of two product lines has a web presence and the framing business effectively does not. Treat as a split-identity problem pending full audit.
